 K-Beauty Group Goodai Global Files for IPO
 Published November 15, 2026 
 BeautyMatter Business 
 Published November 15, 2026 
 Finance 
 Skincare 
 Cosmetics 
 Body Care 
 Beauty of Joseon 
 Key Takeaways: 
 Goodai Global, the South Korean cosmetics company behind ​the Beauty of Joseon and ‌Skin1004 brands, has filed for an IPO.
 The company has been pursuing an acquisition‑led expansion strategy similar to global beauty conglomerates.
 The listing could value it at $6 billion to $7.5 billion.
 South Korean beauty group Goodai Global submitted an application for a preliminary listing review to the Korea Exchange on November 13 for the first formal step toward a listing on the main Kospi board. The listing could value it at $6 billion to $7.5 billion.
 Founded in 2015 by beauty industry veteran and CEO Cheon Joo-hyuk as a beauty manufacturer and distributor, Goodai Global has grown into a multi-brand powerhouse through an aggressive M&A strategy. Its portfolio includes Beauty of Joseon, Tirtir, Round Lab, Skin1004, Torriden , and Skinfood . In early 2026, Goodai bought the US distributor Hansung USA, securing direct control of North American retail and logistics. The roll‑up strategy generally preserves each brand’s concept while centralizing back‑end functions.
 At the end of 2025, Goodai Global secured a KRW 800 billion ($600 million) funding round from investors including IMM Private Equity, JKL Partners, Premier Partners, Kiwoom Private Equity, and Company K Partners, valuing the business at $3.1 billion. The capital supported the company’s M&A strategy, specifically the acquisition of K‑beauty brand Round Lab’s operator Seorin Company, and Skinfood, as well as its plan to go public.
